column1: Table Title: Civil Aircraft Arrivals And Departures, Passengers, Air Cargo Tonnage And Mail - Changi Airport, Monthly
Source: CIVIL AVIATION AUTHORITY OF SINGAPORE

Data from January 1989 refers to Changi Airport only.  Data covers all aircraft services.  Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 9.1.2.
Total Aircraft Arrivals And Departures -> Aircraft Arrivals (Number):
Refers to commercial passenger and cargo aircraft arrivals.
Total Aircraft Arrivals And Departures -> Aircraft Departures (Number):
Refers to commercial passenger and cargo aircraft departures.
Refer to arriving, departing and in transit passengers.  Data are used for SDG 9.1.2 'Passenger and freight volumes, by mode of transport'.

Refers to passengers who arrived and departed on the same aircraft with the same flight number within 24 hours of scheduled time of arrival, to a country other than the country from which they embarked.

Refers to Changi Airport only.  Data exclude passenger baggage, diplomatic cargo and aircraft stores.  Data provided are based on flight origin/destination.  Total is the sum of Imports and Exports.  Data are used for SDG 9.1.2 'Passenger and freight volumes, by mode of transport'.
Total Air Cargo Tonnage -> Imports Of Air Cargo Tonnage (Tonne):

Refers to Changi Airport only.  Data exclude passenger baggage, diplomatic cargo and aircraft stores.  Data provided are based on flight origin/destination.  Imports is a sum of direct imports and tranship imports.  Direct imports refer to cargo that arrived directly from origin and are offloaded in Singapore.  Tranship imports refer to cargo that arrived and transited via Singapore.
Total Air Cargo Tonnage -> Exports Of Air Cargo Tonnage (Tonne):

Refers to Changi Airport only.  Data exclude passenger baggage, diplomatic cargo and aircraft stores.  Data provided are based on flight origin/destination.  Exports is a sum of direct exports and tranship exports.  Direct exports refer to cargo that are uploaded in Singapore and departed directly to destination.  Transhipment exports refer to cargo that departed after transiting in Singapore.
Mail tonnage consist of parcels and letters as declared by airlines.

Values are shown in Singapore dollars (unless otherwise specified).
